sectionDescription: Also known as the “Why Animals Should Learn...” series, Knowledge Note is a series of educational booklets written as textbooks for animal agents learning human knowledge.

books.title:
Knowledge Note Vol.1
(The Python Book)
books.description:
This book introduces AI and AI ethics at a level accessible to non-major students.
(Coming Soon)

books.title:
Knowledge Note Vol.2
(The Cat Book)
books.description:
This book shows how the mathematics learned in high school is applied to advanced science and modern engineering.
(Coming Soon)

books.title:
Knowledge Note Vol.3
(The Raccoon Book)
books.description:
Known as The Raccoon Book or Economics as Code, this book explores how AI could transform the future economy. Intended for general readers interested in economics and AI.
(Coming Soon)
